## apiome migrations {#migrations}

List a project's migration plans (rules that move data from one version to another).

```text
apiome migrations [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`list`](#migrations-list).

## apiome migrations list {#migrations-list}

List a project's migration plans, newest first (GET /v1/migration-plans/{tenant}/projects/{project}).

The table shows PLAN ID, FROM and TO version, how many CLASSES and RULES the plan maps, and when it was UPDATED. --from / --to keep only the plans between those versions. --json prints the matching plans as one JSON array (rule bodies left out — the rule count is kept).

```text
apiome migrations list [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `--from` | text |  |  | Only plans from this version: label (2.0.0 or v2.0.0), UUID or tag. |
| `--to` | text |  |  | Only plans to this version: label (2.1.0 or v2.1.0), UUID or tag. |
| `--limit` | integer range | `50` |  | Show at most this many plans. |
| `--all` | flag |  |  | Show every plan (ignores --limit). |
| `--json` | flag |  |  | Print the plans as one JSON array (same as the global --json). |
